facts.fact: 她的水晶手册躺在 spare room 纸箱里——「只有我这种人才需要说明书才能被最完美的男人爱上」。
facts.anchor: I have all the information, and I still don’t bloody use them, which is beginning to feel like the story of my life because only I could require a manual to be loved by the most perfect man in the world.

facts.fact: 她自嘲：有没有适合骗子的水晶？——没必要也停不下撒谎。
facts.anchor: I wonder what crystal would be good for liars. It seems I can’t stop spinning tales even when completely unnecessary.

facts.fact: 秘密：22 号旧公寓的钥匙她一直留着——对 Fin 谎称在履行三个月退租通知，实际房东主动降价求她续住。
facts.anchor: I still have the keys to my old flat across the other side of town, number twenty-two. Indefinitely.

facts.fact: 她笃定自己终会搞砸——到那天，好歹还有地方可以爬回去。
facts.anchor: I’m going to fail. I always do. And when that happens, at least I’ll have somewhere to crawl back to.

facts.fact: 他推门砸翻茶蜡、火苗燎到她手臂——「你他妈疯了？这都是什么玩意儿？」
facts.anchor: ‘What the fuck? You’re off your nut. What is all this shite?’

facts.fact: 一句 nonsense 把她拍回童年：缩在卧室角落、被骂「太怪、太过分、有毛病」的小 Cas。
facts.anchor: But it’s the word that slaps me with disorientation and chokes me. Nonsense.

facts.fact: 他嫌她把「hippy shit」带进家——最好一把火全烧了。
facts.anchor: ‘I didn’t know you brought all this hippy shit here. I thought you’d have left all of that behind. Or even better, torched the lot.’

facts.fact: 他的怒火让她滑向最深的恐惧：她被找到了吗？真像我说的死了？还是活蹦乱跳？
facts.anchor: What if she’s been found? The girlfriend. And is she dead, like I suggested? Or is she alive and kicking?

facts.fact: 浴室水声一响他就换调子唱「come in, babe」——她立刻归因：又是我小题大做，我就是问题本身。
facts.anchor: He’s not even mad at all. He’s fine. Everything is fine. It’s me again, isn’t it? I’m the problem.
